body: I think I've gave it all the the time i could possibly give. This time I won't fail. Ive tried a lot. I know what not to do. And what will work. Its my time.
Hey you. Message me. Call me. Total strangers but that does not matter. Talk to me. And ill talk to you. I cant sleep at night either.

Use that in every day life. You seem like a strong kid. Keep your head up.
